'''Rhigar''' was a [[Water/Legends|snowy]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions']] [[Rata Nebula/Legends|Rata Nebula]] and the [[Rhigar system/Legends|Rhigar system]] controlled by the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy's]] [[Nuruodo family]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by three [[Moon/Legends|moons]]: [[Rhigar's forested moon]], [[Asdroni]], and [[Rhigar 3]].<ref name="RSBF" /> The site of the [[Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo training academy]],<ref name="DK" /> the snowy celestial body was where military personnel were trained for service under [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], who was also known by his [[Core name/Legends|core name]] "Thrawn, [[Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo's Household Phalanx|Household Phalanx]]."<ref name="RSBF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rhigar<ref name="TEA" /> appeared, albeit unnamed, in the [[2001]] short story ''[[Red Sky, Blue Flame]]'', which was written by [[Elaine Cunningham]] and published within the [[Star Wars Gamer 7|seventh]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine.<ref name="RSBF" /> It was first identified as Rhigar by the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA" />
